summary.text: Walter "Rocky" Beach is an unaffiliated candidate for Louisiana's 2nd Congressional District, a paramedic of more than 37 years who co-founded EMS Reform. His campaign website focuses on EMS funding, first responder protections and ending ambulance monopolies.

paragraphs.text: Graduated from Chester High School and earned an associate degree from the University of Louisiana at Lafayette (1991) and a bachelor's degree from Southeastern Louisiana University (2004).
Says he has worked as a paramedic for more than 37 years, alongside firefighters, law enforcement, dispatchers, nurses and doctors; describes himself as "not a career politician."

sources.title: Walter "Rocky" Beach for U.S. House — Louisiana's 2nd District
